description: REQ-004 claims the new `outcome` key is 'set on EVERY return path (not just the live-share path)' and the Ground Truth section enumerates exactly 6 pre-share early-return sites (:95,108,127,134,141,163). Re-reading post_reel.py's real control flow shows a 7th output path the spec never mentions: the top-level `except Exception as e: res["error"] = repr(e)[:200]` handler (post_reel.py:187-188), which wraps the ENTIRE main() body (from the initial navigate through the post-share search loop) and falls through to the unconditional `finally: print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False))` (post_reel.py:189-190). Any exception raised anywhere in that block (e.g. a CDP navigate timeout mid-search-loop, a websocket error during file-chooser load, a KeyError from an unexpected DOM shape) produces a JSON output with no `outcome` key at all -- not one of the spec's 3 documented values, but entirely ABSENT. Neither REQ-004 nor REQ-005/006/007's run.sh routing logic specifies what run.sh should do when `outcome` is missing/None (as opposed to one of 'published'/'unverified'/'failed'). Since REQ-004 explicitly claims completeness ('EVERY return path') and PROP-004(b) instructs the Phase-3 adversary to confirm 'outcome is set ONLY via classify_outcome's return' for the post-share branch and inline for the 6 sites, a future adversary has no instruction covering this 7th path, so it will predictably be missed again.

evidence.snippet:
except Exception as e:
    res["error"] = repr(e)[:200]
finally:
    print(json.dumps(res, ensure_ascii=False))
